name: Pancake Stretch
description: Fold forward from a wide seated straddle to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.

items.content: Sit tall with legs spread to a comfortable width and knees and toes facing upward.
Tilt the pelvis forward and hinge at the hips, keeping the spine long.
Rest the hands in front for support; stop before the back collapses or the knees twist.
Use a folded blanket under the hips or soften the knees if needed.
Breathe in a mild stretch without bouncing or forcing the chest to the floor.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Seated with legs spread wide, knees and toes facing upward, and heels on the floor. Torso leans forward from the hips with a long back and hands resting on the floor ahead.
